note: The two rules over every boss and enemy (plans/active/VERDANT_PALE_REBUILD.md, 5.1 and 5.2): tests/unit/move-visual-lifetime.test.ts and tests/unit/boss-tell-weight.test.ts. Every list here may only shrink, and the tests fail on an entry that no longer applies. This is a gate file (config/gate-files.json): adding an entry, or raising the cap, needs the lead's review.

reach.about: What separates a body from a mark, in pixels past the entity's own box. measuredBodyReach is the furthest any entity off the hand-drawn list draws (Aldric's cleaver in a lunge); measuredNearestMarkReach is the least, among the hand-drawn entities that reach past markReach, of how far each reaches (the Geomancer's wall and the Gravedigger's arc). The test re-measures both over every fight and fails if either moves.
